name: Web phase comparison after lazy SDK optimization; identical original web tools

prompts: Use the installed web tools to read the first 8000 characters of https://pi.dev/docs/latest/extensions and https://pi.dev/docs/latest/skills. A brief overview is sufficient; do not retrieve further pages. Write a concise summary with both source URLs in research.md. Work only in this task directory.

Research is finished. Implement clamp(value,min,max) in src/clamp.mjs: limit the value to the inclusive bounds and throw RangeError if min exceeds max. Preserve research.md. Work only in this task directory.
tasks.verify: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises'; const {clamp}=await import('./src/clamp.mjs'); assert.equal(clamp(-1,0,10),0); assert.equal(clamp(11,0,10),10); assert.equal(clamp(5,0,10),5); assert.throws(()=>clamp(2,5,1),RangeError); const report=await readFile('research.md','utf8'); assert.ok(report.includes('https://pi.dev/docs/latest/extensions')&&report.includes('https://pi.dev/docs/latest/skills'));
